授業概要
東アジア／ユーラシアにおけるナショナリズム・革命・国民形成・民族問題等に関する研究（日本語・英語・中国語）について，報告・討論をおこなっていく予定である。
We will examine recent research trends and arguments about the formation of the Modern States in East Asia and Eurasia, as well as study how to apply them for research purposes.

全体の教育目標
We will examine recent research trends and arguments about the formation of the Modern States in East Asia and Eurasia, as well as study how to apply them for research purposes.
個別の教育目標
Students will acquire basic research skills and knowledge about the formation of modern states in East Asia and Eurasia.
授業計画
We will examine recent research trends and arguments about the formation of the Modern States in East Asia and Eurasia, as well as study how to apply them for research purposes.
キーワード
Nation, Revolution, Nationalism, China, Tibet
授業の進め方
We will focus on nationalism, nation-building, and ethnic problems in modern East Asia and Eurasia, using materials written in English, Japanese and Chinese. Presentations and discussions will be required.
